scripts.build: pnpm build:lib && pnpm build:example && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.build:example: pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'anchor build --no-idl --ignore-keys && mkdir -p target/idl && anchor idl build -p demo -o target/idl/demo.json' anchor
scripts.build:example:native: pnpm exec lz-tool --docker-platform native --script 'anchor build --no-idl --ignore-keys && mkdir -p target/idl && anchor idl build -p demo -o target/idl/demo.json' anchor
scripts.build:lib: pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo build -p heap-allocator' anchor
scripts.build:lib:native: pnpm exec lz-tool --docker-platform native --script 'cargo build -p heap-allocator' anchor
scripts.build:native: pnpm build:lib:native && pnpm build:example:native && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.lint:rs: pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings' anchor
